draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Kanpur to Ludhiana Route
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Kanpur to Ludhiana Route

Dear Apex Chemicals Team,

Please be advised that the vehicle with registration UP54XZ6139 has experienced a breakdown and is being replaced.
A replacement vehicle, registration UP17GN7381, has been dispatched from our Kanpur hub to continue the Kanpur to Ludhiana route.
The estimated time of arrival for the shipment is approximately 21.3 hours from the time of dispatch.
We are monitoring the situation closely to ensure minimal disruption to your logistics schedule.
Please let us know if you require any further details regarding this update.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
